strings.name: Viktor Orbán
strings.summary: A law graduate and Fidesz co-founder, Orbán governed in 1998–2002 and 2010–2026. His institutional changes, migration policy and EU disputes shaped European politics amid criticism of democratic backsliding. Defeated in April 2026, he left office in May; parliament then adopted a cumulative term limit effectively preventing his return.
